paite: Asuangphum tang siangthou ah a-om hi.
heading: Korah tapate phatna La / Jerusalem Phatna

paite: TOUPA'N Zion kulh kongkhakte Jakob omna tengteng sang in a-itzaw ahi.
Pathian khopi aw, na tungthu thupitak in agen uhi. Selah
Hon theite lak ah apang sam uh chih Rahab leh Babulon tungtang thu ka gen ding; Philistia leh Tura, Ethiopia toh, "En un, hiai mi huai lai a piang ahi," achi ua.
Zion tungtang thu gen ahih chiang in, "Hiai mi leh huai mi amah a piang ahi; Tungnungpen ngei in amah ahihkip ding," chi a gen ahi dia;
TOUPA'N, mite' min gelh a akhumlut chiang in, "Hiai mi huai a piang ahi," achi ding a, Selah
Lasate leh lamte'n, "Ka tuikhuk teng nangmah ah ahi a-om," achi ding uhi.
